SC.TP.903.plainName: Material type code is a real value
SC.TP.903.whatItChecks: Material type must be filled in and must not be '-'.
SC.TP.903.failureMeans: The shipment has no material type.

SC.TP.795.plainName: Carrier reference number uses an approved value
SC.TP.795.whatItChecks: Carrier reference number must be filled in and must not be '-'.
SC.TP.795.failureMeans: The shipment has no carrier reference. Obtain it from the carrier and record it at source.

SC.TP.799.plainName: Distance unit of measure code uses an approved value
SC.TP.799.whatItChecks: Distance unit must be KM or mi.
SC.TP.799.failureMeans: The distance unit is missing or not KM/mi.

SC.TP.880.plainName: Estimated shipment chargeable weight unit of measure code uses an approved value
SC.TP.880.whatItChecks: Estimated chargeable weight unit must be KG, G or lbs.
SC.TP.880.failureMeans: The weight unit is missing or not KG/G/lbs.

SC.TP.801.plainName: Incoterms code uses an approved value
SC.TP.801.whatItChecks: Incoterms code must be one of the standard Incoterms (EXW, FOB, DAP, DDP, …).
SC.TP.801.failureMeans: The Incoterms code is missing or not a recognised term. Correct it on the shipment.

SC.TP.802.plainName: Incoterms location name uses an approved value
SC.TP.802.whatItChecks: Incoterms location must be filled in and must not be '-'.
SC.TP.802.failureMeans: The shipment has no Incoterms location.

SC.TP.812.plainName: Shipment archetype description uses an approved value
SC.TP.812.whatItChecks: Shipment archetype must be filled in and must not be '-'.
SC.TP.812.failureMeans: The shipment has no archetype classification.

SC.TP.845.plainName: Shipment temperature code uses an approved value
SC.TP.845.whatItChecks: Shipping temperature code must be one of T1–T13 or TX.
SC.TP.845.failureMeans: The temperature code is missing or not an approved code.

SC.TP.906.plainName: CO2 emissions value (kg) is within range
SC.TP.906.whatItChecks: CO2 emissions (kg) must be greater than zero.
SC.TP.906.failureMeans: The emissions value is missing or zero.

SC.TP.905.plainName: CO2 factor value is within range
SC.TP.905.whatItChecks: CO2 factor must be between 0 and 1.
SC.TP.905.failureMeans: The CO2 factor is missing or outside 0–1.

SC.TP.792.whatItChecks: Container quantity must be a whole number greater than zero.
SC.TP.792.failureMeans: The shipment has no container quantity, or it is zero or not a whole number.

SC.TP.888.plainName: Estimated shipment cost local currency value is within range
SC.TP.888.whatItChecks: Estimated shipping cost (local currency) must be greater than zero.
SC.TP.888.failureMeans: The cost is missing or zero.

SC.TP.895.plainName: Invoiced shipment cost EUR value is within range
SC.TP.895.whatItChecks: Invoiced shipping cost in EUR must be greater than zero.
SC.TP.895.failureMeans: The cost is missing or zero.

SC.TP.889.plainName: Invoiced shipment cost local currency value is within range
SC.TP.889.whatItChecks: Invoiced shipping cost (local currency) must be greater than zero.
SC.TP.889.failureMeans: The cost is missing or zero.

SC.TP.894.plainName: Invoiced shipment cost USD value is within range
SC.TP.894.whatItChecks: Invoiced shipping cost in USD must be greater than zero.
SC.TP.894.failureMeans: The cost is missing or zero.

SC.TP.886.plainName: Shipment material quantity is within range
SC.TP.886.whatItChecks: Shipped material quantity must be zero or more.
SC.TP.886.failureMeans: The quantity is missing or negative.

SC.TP.836.plainName: Estimated arrival time value is in the right format
SC.TP.836.whatItChecks: Estimated arrival time must be a 6-digit time (HHMMSS).
SC.TP.836.failureMeans: The time is missing or not 6 digits.

SC.TP.834.plainName: Goods issue time is in the right format
SC.TP.834.whatItChecks: Goods-issue time must be a 6-digit time (HHMMSS).
SC.TP.834.failureMeans: The time is missing or not 6 digits.

SC.TP.901.plainName: Destination site ID exists in master data
SC.TP.901.whatItChecks: Destination site must exist in the SAP plant master (T001W).
SC.TP.901.failureMeans: The destination site is missing or unknown to SAP.

SC.TP.786.plainName: Origin country code exists in master data
SC.TP.786.whatItChecks: The origin country code must be a valid ISO-2 country code.
SC.TP.786.failureMeans: The origin country code is missing or not a recognised country. Correct it at source.

SC.TP.851.plainName: Last shipment status date is a plausible date
SC.TP.851.whatItChecks: Last shipment status date must not be in the future.
SC.TP.851.failureMeans: The status date is missing or in the future.

SC.TP.806.plainName: Requested pick up date is a plausible date
SC.TP.806.whatItChecks: Requested pick-up date must fall on or after the document creation date and on or before the estimated departure date.
SC.TP.806.failureMeans: The pick-up date is missing or out of sequence with creation/departure dates. Check the dates on the shipment.

SC.TP.892.plainName: Delivery flash number is consistent with related fields
SC.TP.892.whatItChecks: If a PO flash number or flash site is recorded, the delivery flash number must also be recorded.
SC.TP.892.failureMeans: A flash reference is partially filled – the delivery flash number is missing.

SC.TP.902.plainName: Flash site ID is consistent with related fields
SC.TP.902.whatItChecks: If a delivery or PO flash number is recorded, the flash site must also be recorded.
SC.TP.902.failureMeans: A flash reference is partially filled – the flash site is missing.

SC.TP.841.plainName: Flight vessel 2 name is consistent with related fields
SC.TP.841.whatItChecks: Second flight/vessel name must be blank (single-leg shipments).
SC.TP.841.failureMeans: A second leg is recorded where none is expected.
